title: Playing in Jelly Roll's twelve-piece band in the 1940s
summary: Garland worked in Jelly Roll's rehearsal band, which was Ory's whole band plus extra players.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Remembering Jelly Roll Morton: the man, the band

blocks.x: Sounded like an orchestral idea. So did you work with him a little bit in the '40's?
Yeah, oh yeah.
What kind of band did he have then, a
* JELLY ROLL MORTON DIED IN 1941.
big band or --
Yeah. Oh, he was rehearsing this band he had something for records and something else. I don't know. He had 12 of us.
Then, after Jelly Roll, do you go back with Ory, again?
After Jelly Roll, I was with Ory at that time.
At that time, I see.
Ory was in the band with us. Ory.
Ory was in the band with Jelly?
Yes. Bud Scott, yeah.
Who was the trumpet player in that band, then?
Poppa Mutt.
Poppa Mutt was playing, I see. And the drummer?
Ram, yeah. Minor Hall.
So it's the same band from the --
In other words, he had the whole band of Ory's.
I see.
And he made the rest of them up.
I see.
Had Buster Wilson, and all. Had the
whole band.
